Cache the last (Size, Arc<Path>) in a RefCell captured by the closure and reuse it when constraints.biggest() is unchanged, rebuilding only on a size change. Each layout of the PhysicalShape fill layer allocates a new Canvas, a display list entry and a CustomPaint. Reuse the built surface when the size is unchanged (cache keyed on constraints.biggest() in a RefCell captured by the closure), or record the fill directly at paint time so layout does not build a display list.

stages() returns a fresh Vec on every widget conversion, and new() calls it a second time just to check for dilate/erode. Compute the stages once in new() and store them: replace `filter: Option<ImageFilter>` with `stages: Option<Vec<ImageFilter>>` (built from a single `filter.stages()` call), then in From iterate `stages.into_iter()` instead of calling stages() here.
